safety.fault_rearm: explicit local confirmation and passed checks; never automatic
safety.STOP_MOTION: cancel displacement; healthy balancing remains active
safety.physical_disable: Rear SW1 two poles: poleA pulls Q90 gate via10k to control pack load; poleB opens motionJ8 latch clear. Off/reset/fault requires explicit fresh ARM after passed checks; no automatic re-arm. Switch contacts carry only control current. OFF removes balance; cradle required.
safety.interaction_reset: lease expiry revokes displacement; must not reset motion MCU
safety.charge: manual cradle/support confirmation and no free movement
safety.low_battery: provisional10.8V warning/10.2V urgent support, with filtering; require pack/dropout bench calibration. Not BMS-cutoff balancing.
safety.IWDG: Motion firmware must enable independent watchdog; external supervisor is voltage/reset latch, not a software liveness monitor.

charging.ordinary_5V_behavior: UNQUALIFIED: do not attach battery until exact3S module/input limit/CC behavior validated
charging.CAM_USB_backfeed: Maintenance procedure: support/DISARM, disconnect CAM regulated5V pigtail before host USB; never connect both power sources; CAM BAT unused
charging.charge_with_logic_enabled: DISALLOWED in P1 until a qualified power-path charger is selected
charging.rear_board: MORI_rear_P5; interface/protection only, not a charger
charging.CC_termination: External qualified sink must provide independent CC1/CC2 Rd incl dead-battery startup; none on rear board
charging.master_off_charging: Charger must connect to exact finished-pack approved charge terminals before Q90; P-/C- roles unresolved. No battery hookup until selected.

pcb_revision_relationship: Motion P5R1 is a routing-only correction of P5; 70x35 outline, holes, connector poses, BOM and pad/net assignments unchanged. IMU/power/rear remain native P5.

logic_power_startup.sequence: Rear SW1 enables Q90 input. TPS54302 EN internal pullups start both independent5V rails; MCU-local3V3 retained. ARM_Q not required for logic rails. Sequence/inrush tests NOT_TESTED.
logic_power_startup.maintenance: JP60 and JP70 independently ground EN only in cradle; loss of motion3V3 clears actuator ARM.
logic_power_startup.local_regulators: WeAct retains local3V3; CAM retains local regulators; no regulator outputs are paralleled.
logic_power_startup.backfeed: No automatic hostUSB power mux or independent output reverse-blocking added. Disconnect robotCAM5V before hostUSB.
